**1 — Scene:** Rice with a creamy chicken-and-vegetable curry. I’m estimating the main plate on the right only, excluding the separate meat, potatoes, brownie and drinks.

**2 — Vessel:** A shallow dinner plate, approximately **26 cm** across. Area = 3.14 × 13² = **531 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Cooked white rice, chicken pieces, mixed vegetables (including green beans), and creamy curry sauce. Any cooking fat is included in the sauce estimate.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy:** The footprint allocations below total **70%** of the plate; they divide the visible food area without double-counting overlapping sauce and solids.

| Item | Plate area | Area × average height = volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| White rice | 37% | 196 × 1.5 = 294 ml | 0.8 | 235 g | 130 | 306 kcal |
| Chicken pieces | 14% | 74 × 1.6 = 118 ml | 0.95 | 112 g | 185 | 207 kcal |
| Mixed vegetables | 7% | 37 × 1.2 = 44 ml | 0.6 | 27 g | 35 | 9 kcal |
| Creamy curry sauce | 12% | 64 × 0.8 = 51 ml | 1.0 | 51 g | 140 | 71 kcal |

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **425 g and 595 kcal** is plausible for this substantial, partially covered dinner plate. Sauce richness and the depth of rice underneath it are the main uncertainties.
